title: The Hunting Battle
summary: The Hunting Battle begins: each side must take a scale from a Fire Python Tiger, a beast as strong as a Heavenly Yuan fighter. Before it starts, Xie Yingying slaps Qing Tan and tries to take the Yin Pearl necklace Lin Dong gave her, and Lin Dong slaps her back, angering her fiancé Lei Li. In the forest Lin Dong agrees to work with Wu Yun, young master of the Raging Blade Dojo. Wu Yun grabs a scale but falls into Lei Li's trap, and Lei Li kicks him into the tiger's den; Lin Dong jumps in after him. Inside, the dying tigress turns out to be guarding two cubs, and Lin Dong picks the sickly one. Back in the arena Lei Bao stakes Ironwood Manor on a final duel between Lin Dong and Lei Li for the cubs, and Lin Dong accepts.
events: Lin Zhentian meets Luo Cheng, Lei Bao and Xie Qian at the Hunting Battle; the target is the Fire Python Tiger.
Xie Yingying bullies Qing Tan over her Yin Pearl necklace; Lin Dong slaps her and Lei Li threatens him.
Wu Yun steps in, then offers Lin Dong an alliance in the forest.
Lin Dong holds off Earthly Yuan Lei Li while Wu Yun takes a scale.
Lei Li traps Wu Yun and kicks him into the tiger's cave; Lin Dong jumps after him.
The tigress dies guarding two cubs; Wu Yun lets Lin Dong choose, and he takes the sickly one.
They return alive with the cubs; Lei Bao stakes Ironwood Manor on a duel with Lei Li for them.
cultivation: Lin Dong reached Tempered Body 9th layer half a month before the hunt. Lei Li is at Earthly Yuan. The Fire Python Tiger is equal to a Heavenly Yuan fighter.

The cub is not yet named Little Flame here (named 小炎 in EP4); it is the cub Lin Dong picks at 1194.2.
The Fire Python Tiger's realm is an equivalence (相当于天元境), not a human realm.
